label: 💥 Crack (0.1 beta)
description:
A hybrid-rate drum voice: a record-ready modern snare at the home settings, then a whole percussion kit under the macros. Three sine modes with two pitch envelopes, head-coupled wires and clap, a tuned ring and a 24 kHz heat chain, with a full-rate click and air layer.

WIRES: 0 head only, 64 modern wires, 96 snare+clap, 127 clap only. BODY: 0 thump, 64 membrane, 127 metal. SNAP: 0 brush, 64 modern snap, 127 zap. HEAT: 0 raw, 64 smack, 127 destroyed. PUNCH = rimshot, GATE sustains, velocity opens the crack.

Recipes: hero snare, rimshot, ghost note, trap clap-snare, 808, 909, brush, gated 80s, kick, tom, clap, metallic hat, metal hit, zap, crushed lo-fi, sustained bass. Default trig is 196 Hz / G3.
